verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Databricks supports data orchestration via Lakeflow pipelines/ETL (docs-1, docs-40), a documented Jobs REST API (v2.0) for automation (databricks-supp-versioned-apis), and CLI/SDK tools explicitly built for automation scripts (docs-2, docs-48, docs-49, docs-77), all of which are the building blocks for scheduling recurring jobs/workflows. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents a cron/schedule trigger UI or recurring-schedule configuration for an 'AI-native' user, nor independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow. missing for 10: explicit docs on schedule/cron trigger configuration for Jobs/Workflows, independent or hands-on verification that recurring scheduling works reliably for AI-native automation.
